tool_args.rationale: The previous model execution failed because its parameter state was undefined. This corrected self-contained implementation fits steady-state gain and decay rate numerically from all eight observations, using the supplied adiabatic relaxation form and preserving fitted parameters for prediction.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The fine trajectory batch has already been acquired; no additional probe is listed in the cost menu.
It ignores the supplied fast-transient signature and x_now variation; the coarse adiabatic relaxation model captures both while estimating parameters from all rows.
These alternatives are less consistent with the observed near-linear dependence on u_now and the pilot signatures; fitting the supported coarse relaxation model is the economical next step.
